actions.action: Expire and delete records after at most five minutes.
actions.mechanism: Separate freshness checks from background cleanup so delayed cleanup cannot make expired records appear fresh.
actions.implementation: Set a monotonic expiry deadline no later than 300 seconds after retrieval starts. Check it on every read; delete expired entries before responding. Schedule deletion at expiry. Never extend expiry on hits or source failures.
actions.check: With a controlled clock, verify a record is unavailable at its deadline, including when cleanup is delayed and the source is down.
actions.risk: Strict expiry sacrifices availability during a prolonged outage.

actions.action: Enforce a hard 100-record capacity with explicit eviction.
actions.mechanism: Bound admission rather than relying on periodic size checks.
actions.implementation: Use 100 cache slots, counting pending retrieval reservations against capacity. Under one lock, remove expired entries first; otherwise evict the least-recently-used completed entry when admitting a new key. If every slot is reserved, reject admission. Release reservations on failure; never restore an expired victim.
actions.check: Request 150 distinct keys concurrently. Assert occupied slots plus reservations never exceed 100 and verify the documented eviction order.
actions.risk: Unpopular requests can evict useful records; reservations temporarily reduce available capacity.

actions.action: Return an explicit unavailable response when the source times out.
actions.mechanism: Bound waiting and share retrieval work for simultaneous requests for the same record.
actions.implementation: Configure a source timeout, such as two seconds. Serve only unexpired cache hits; otherwise share one in-flight retrieval per key. On timeout, cancel retrieval, release its reservation, and return HTTP 503 with code source_timeout. Discard late results and retain unrelated unexpired entries.
actions.check: Hold the source beyond the timeout. Verify same-key requests share one retrieval, receive 503, leave no reservation, and cannot receive an expired record.
actions.risk: A short timeout can reject a slow but functioning source.

actions.action: Admit only explicitly approved public record fields.
actions.mechanism: Use a restricted record representation instead of retaining complete source responses.
actions.implementation: Restrict retrieval to approved public endpoints without user credentials. Stream-parse responses into an allowlisted schema with field-size limits; do not retain raw bodies or log payloads. Reject unexpected fields rather than silently caching them.
actions.check: Inject an unexpected sensitive field and an oversized value. Verify rejection and absence from cache, responses, and logs; verify an approved public record succeeds.
actions.risk: Schema changes can interrupt retrieval; an allowlist still requires verification that approved fields are genuinely public.
